lines.text: The LORD tells Edom, who dwells in the clefts of the rocks, that He will bring it down even from the eagle's height.
Edom's allies will drive them to the border, and the mighty men of Teman will be terrified.
Because of violence against his brother Jacob, Edom will be cut off forever, since it stood aloof while foreigners cast lots for Jerusalem.
The house of Jacob will be a blazing fire and the house of Benjamin a burning flame, while Esau will be stubble.
Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau, and Benjamin will possess Bashan.
